note: rebuild-by-m is a vanilla static HTML/CSS/JS site (no package.json, no React, no Storybook — see CLAUDE.md). It is outside the design-sync converter's envelope, which expects a componentized (React/Storybook) repo. This sync was produced by hand: real design tokens from css/cinema.css plus real HTML/CSS pattern snippets lifted from the live pages, uploaded as static preview cards. No _ds_bundle.js / .d.ts / .prompt.md were generated because there is no JS component API to describe.
